# Desert Vintage Restoration (Kerblabs concept)

> Family-owned restoration, body and paint shop at 103 S River Dr, Tempe, AZ 85288. Founded 2015 by Larry Garrel with sons Samuel and Joseph. Phone 480-625-0329. Facts from desertvintagerestoration.com. This is an unaffiliated concept site.

## Services
- Vehicle restoration
- Body and paint work
- Paint correction
- General repairs (engine, transmission, exhaust, suspension), brake service, oil change and maintenance, tires, battery and electrical
